shortDescription: Configures the iDRAC services related attributes

options.name: alert_port
options.description: The iDRAC port number that must be used for SNMP traps. The default value is 162, and the acceptable range is between 1 to 65535.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: community_name
options.description: SNMP community name for iDRAC. It is used by iDRAC to validate SNMP queries received from remote systems requesting SNMP data access.

options.name: discovery_port
options.description: The SNMP agent port on the iDRAC. The default value is 161, and the acceptable range is between 1 to 65535.

options.name: enable_web_server
options.description: Whether to Enable or Disable webserver configuration for iDRAC.

options.name: http_port
options.description: HTTP access port.

options.name: https_port
options.description: HTTPS access port.

options.name: idrac_ip
options.description: iDRAC IP Address.

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password.

options.name: idrac_port
options.description: iDRAC port.

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username.

options.name: ipmi_lan
options.description: Community name set on iDRAC for SNMP settings.

options.name: share_mnt
options.description: (deprecated)Local mount path of the network share with read-write permission for ansible user. This option is mandatory for Network Share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_name
options.description: (deprecated)Network share or a local path. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_password
options.description: (deprecated)Network share user password. This option is mandatory for CIFS Network Share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_user
options.description: (deprecated)Network share user in the format 'user@domain' or 'domain\user' if user is part of a domain else 'user'. This option is mandatory for CIFS Network Share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: snmp_enable
options.description: Whether to Enable or Disable SNMP protocol for iDRAC.

options.name: snmp_protocol
options.description: Type of the SNMP protocol.

options.name: ssl_encryption
options.description: Secure Socket Layer encryption for webserver.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout value.

options.name: tls_protocol
options.description: Transport Layer Security for webserver.

options.name: trap_format
options.description: SNMP trap format for iDRAC.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.
